manifest.name: Booking — Stay Reservations
manifest.description: Search stays and view your bookings and QR card even offline (portfolio/demo project).

trips.title: My trips
trips.intro: Your upcoming bookings. Once opened, this page is available without an internet connection.
trips.empty: You have no upcoming confirmed bookings.
trips.loginRequired: Sign in to see your trips.
trips.offlineBanner: You are offline — showing the itinerary saved on {time}. Later changes may not appear here.
trips.offlineUnavailable: You are offline and no itinerary has been saved yet. Open this page once while online.
trips.qrHint: Show this QR code at check-in. It contains no personal data; the property verifies it on the server.
trips.accountQrHint: The QR card for your upcoming stays is on <link>My trips</link>.
trips.copyFailed: Could not copy; select the number and copy it manually.
trips.emptyNote: Bookings awaiting payment or cancelled bookings are not shown here.

push.title: Push notifications
push.description: Get notified on this device when a stay on your price alert drops in price and before check-in.
push.disabledServer: Push notifications are not available right now; email notifications keep working.
push.unsupported: Your browser does not support push notifications.
push.denied: Notification permission was denied. You can allow it in your browser settings.
push.error: The notification setting could not be changed.
push.dismissed: Notification permission was not granted. You can try again if you like.
push.disabledDone: Notifications are turned off on this device.
push.deniedHelp: To allow them, tap the lock icon in the address bar and set Notifications to "Allow"; then press "Check permission again".
push.iosInstall: To get notifications on iPhone or iPad, choose "Add to Home Screen" from the browser's Share menu, then open the app from the Home Screen icon and come back to this page (iOS 16.4 or later).
push.notReady: The notification service could not start on this device. Reload the page and try again.
push.recheckError: The permission could not be checked. Check your connection and try again.
push.stillDenied: Notification permission is still blocked. Allow it in your browser settings and check again.
push.allowedNow: Notification permission is now allowed; you can turn on notifications on this device.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: This page is not available offline. If you opened My trips earlier while online, it and your booking QR card open offline too.
offline.reconnect: When your connection is back, this page reloads by itself. If you don't want to wait, press “Try again”.

network.offline: You are offline — try again once the connection is back.
